item.description:
Before SpaceCorps 2027, there was a browser game Back on January 11, 2026, update 0.0.5 of our browser prototype laid the foundation. Ship combat against players and aliens, portal jumps, a minimap, quests, a shop and a drag-and-drop hangar. Eight months later we rebuilt it as a native game. Free on Steam, link in bio.
